field_checks.summary: Requested paths were readable. I independently inspected the XML Table 1 and PDF Table 1/Figure 6 surfaces. The positive SM07 MIC row is correctly captured as 4 ug/mL against Pseudomonas aeruginosa ATCC27853, and all 12 SM07 Table 1 rows are represented, but current final structured exclusions still contain internally inconsistent target objects and Figure 6 plotted toxicity values remain unextracted.

No linked authoritative DBAASP/merged article, assay, literature, or sequence rows are present. The two DBAASP machine fallback rows use sequence='None' and remain unresolved candidate evidence, with source_verified_count 0 and authoritative ingest disabled. This is correctly preserved as a caution boundary, not a release-ready database record.

All layer final mirrors are byte-identical for paper/packet activity, database, review, mechanism_ontology, and packet mechanism_evidence alias. Counts reviewed: 1 activity record, 1 toxicity record, 1 database audit/record, 4 mechanism claims, 0 review rework targets. The live rework state computes to 0 open tickets, matching packet status and strict acceptance status.

Mechanism claims preserve evidence-class boundaries: computational_only 1, phenotype_supported 1, inferred_mechanism 1, unknown_or_not_tested 1, direct_mechanism 0. The paper discussion states catalytic/domain interpretations are in silico or hypothesis-generating and require direct biochemical validation, so no direct mechanism is promoted.

Primary paper identity is source-supported: PMCID PMC13025223, PMID 41899469, DOI 10.3390/cimb48030318, 2026 Current Issues in Molecular Biology article on SM07. SM07 is a 1383 bp phage-derived lytic protein ORF expressed with an N-terminal His6 tag; no final object contains both a plain one-letter sequence and sequence_length requiring residue-count reconciliation.

Primary locators resolve and previous recursive project-path source_locator defects are repaired, but final activity exclusions still have unsupported or contradictory normalized target objects: EXCL-004/005 top-level fields preserve BAA747 while nested target.strain_or_isolate says not_reported; EXCL-009/010 preserve raw ESCCO ATCC 25922 at top level while nested target silently says Escherichia coli ATCC25922 without a paper-local normalization locator.

Recursive scan found no true authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready or authoritative_ingest_ready values in current work, analysis, paper final, packet final, or database packet artifacts. Fallback machine rows remain candidate-only and are not promoted to RC2, portal, or authoritative ingest.

Cautions are preserved for absent authoritative database linkage, fallback rows candidate-only, and no standalone supplementary assets. The remaining source-vs-final conflict is the worker-2 target/toxicity field issue reported as blocking rather than hidden by these cautions.

The staged paper supplementary directory and packet raw supplementary_original directory are readable and empty; supplementary_index, supplementary_text, supplementary_tables, and archive_manifest are empty with extraction_error_count 0. The XML contains a PDF self-uri and graphics but no staged standalone supplement file requiring extraction.

Selectivity coverage includes 11 SM07 ND/non-numeric exclusions plus the positive MIC, but target/strain normalization is internally inconsistent for A. baumannii BAA747 and ESCCO ATCC 25922 exclusions. Toxicity is represented only as qualitative text with approximate_graph_values empty even though PDF Figure 6 visibly plots percent-toxicity versus concentration for lysin and PBS.

blocking_findings.reason: Current final activity_toxicity_evidence is not publication-grade source-reviewable. In Table 1 structured SM07 exclusions, EXCL-004/005 inherit source target Acinetobacter baumannii BAA747, but nested target.strain_or_isolate remains not_reported while top-level target_strain_or_isolate is BAA747. EXCL-009/010 preserve raw source target ESCCO ATCC 25922 and normalization_status=ambiguous at top level, but nested target.species is Escherichia coli and strain_or_isolate is ATCC25922 without a paper-local locator supporting that normalization. The toxicity record also leaves approximate_graph_values empty despite PDF Figure 6 plotting % toxicity by concentration; qualitative text alone does not exhaust the plotted value surface.
required_actions: Rebuild worker-2 Table 1 SM07 exclusions so every target representation, including nested target objects, preserves the source target/strain or explicitly marks a source-backed ambiguity without contradictory normalized species fields.

For ESCCO ATCC 25922, either preserve the raw ambiguous label in all target fields or cite a concrete primary-source locator supporting normalization to Escherichia coli; do not silently normalize only one field branch.

Extract Figure 6 toxicity as approximate graph-derived per-concentration observations with % toxicity and concentration units, or mark the graph value surface as a blocking material rework gap rather than publication-grade exhausted evidence.
Mirror the repaired activity_toxicity_evidence to paper and packet finals and have worker-6 re-adjudicate after the repaired artifact is present.
acceptance_checks: A parser over xml:table-wrap:1 with rowspan propagation finds 12 SM07 rows and every final activity/exclusion row has internally consistent raw_source_target, target_species, target_strain_or_isolate, and nested target.species/strain_or_isolate fields.
No final object for Acinetobacter baumannii BAA747 contains nested target.strain_or_isolate='not_reported' while another field for the same object carries BAA747.

No final object for raw source target ESCCO ATCC 25922 contains nested target.species='Escherichia coli' unless the object also contains a source-backed normalization locator and preserves the raw label as ambiguous.

toxicity_records include either non-empty approximate_graph_values with concentration, concentration_unit, % toxicity, exactness_status=approximate_graph_digitized, and source_locator=pdf:page=9:figure=Figure 6, or an open blocking material rework ticket for Figure 6 value extraction.

Paper and packet activity_toxicity_evidence.json are byte-identical after repair; live packet open_rework_ticket_count equals the strict acceptance artifact status; semantic and publication gates are rerun after the repair.
